verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a graph-based Workflow Runtime with "state management" and "retry", persistent Artifacts, and managed deployment targets (Agent Runtime, Cloud Run). None of it documents agents or workflows surviving process restarts or deploys, such as checkpointing, resume-from-failure, persistent session stores, or durable-execution integrations. These are adjacent features (in-run state, output persistence, hosting) rather than the durability capability itself, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run long-lived agents durably across process restarts and deploys, natively or via durable-execution integrations
